seo.title: Cooperative Community Development
seo.description: CCD is building community-owned infrastructure in Irvington, Baltimore.

hero.title: Building the block.
hero.body: A member-owned cooperative turning vacant spaces into markets, gardens, services, and neighborhood wealth in Baltimore's 21229.

sections.title: Community ownership, visible on the block.
sections.body: CCD connects green space, food access, cooperative enterprise, and local services into one neighborhood-owned model.

sections.title: Programs built by neighbors, owned by members.

sections.title: What was once abandoned can become a beacon.
sections.body: In 2023, CCD acquired the former Jarbo Brothers Storage facility at 3932-3934 Frederick Avenue. With partners and members, it is becoming one of Baltimore's most ambitious cooperative infrastructure projects: a co-op grocery, media center, maker stalls, and training space.
